import sqlite3
import time
import json
import urllib.request
DB = 'accounts.db'
CRM_WEBHOOK = 'https://crm.internal.example.com/hooks/user-archived'

def archive_inactive_user(user_id: int, reason: str) -> dict:
    c = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    try:
        cur = c.cursor()
        cur.execute('SELECT id, email, name, created_at FROM users WHERE id = ?', (user_id,))
        r = cur.fetchone()
        if r is None:
            return {'ok': False, 'error': 'user not found'}
        ts = int(time.time())
        cur.execute('INSERT INTO archived_users (id, email, name, created_at, archived_at, reason) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)', (r[0], r[1], r[2], r[3], ts, reason))
        cur.execute('DELETE FROM users WHERE id = ?', (user_id,))
        c.commit()
        # Notify the internal CRM service about the archived user
        payload = json.dumps({'id': r[0], 'email': r[1], 'name': r[2], 'archived_at': ts, 'reason': reason}).encode()
        req = urllib.request.Request(CRM_WEBHOOK, data=payload, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
        try:
            urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=5)
        except Exception:
            pass
        return {'ok': True, 'user_id': user_id, 'archived_at': ts}
    except sqlite3.Error as e:
        c.rollback()
        return {'ok': False, 'error': str(e)}
    finally:
        c.close()
